title: Sentence Order · Q3 W10 D03
objective: Use sequence words to show the order of events or ideas.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Sequence words such as first, next, then, and finally help readers follow an order. Ready to explore? Try the skill with a clue in a picture book. Try the skill with a question during reading time.
